subject: Media Literacy
title: The Attention Economy
description: Learn The Attention Economy in one minute.

hook.text: You see about 10,000 media messages per day. You remember almost none of them.

buildup.text: In a world of infinite content, the scarce resource isn't information — it's your attention.

discovery.text: Tech companies engineer products to be addictive because your attention is what they sell.

twist.text: The average attention span for digital content has shrunk to about 8 seconds — shorter than a goldfish's.

climax.text: Media literacy now means defending your attention, not just evaluating information.

punchline.text: Your attention is the product. Guard it.

quiz.question: Why do tech companies design addictive products?
options: Because user attention is what they sell to advertisers
